title: Two ski trips
intro: You paid $100 for a weekend ski trip to Michigan. Weeks later you paid $50 for a ski trip to Wisconsin. You think you will enjoy Wisconsin more. Then you notice both trips are on the same weekend. The tickets are non-refundable and cannot be resold. You must choose one.
question: Which trip do you take?

options.text: The $50 Wisconsin trip (the one you expect to enjoy more)

debrief: The $150 is spent whichever trip you take, so only future enjoyment should matter. 54% of participants nonetheless chose the more expensive, less enjoyable trip to avoid 'wasting' more money.
